author: Okkerka
install_msg:
Install required dependencies: `[p]pipinstall tidalapi spotipy google-api-python-client rapidfuzz`
Then run `>tidalsetup` to authenticate with Tidal.
name: TidalPlayer
short: Play music from Tidal with album art, Spotify/YouTube importing and full metadata.
description: Tidal music integration for Red-DiscordBot. Supports Tidal playback, album art, Spotify playlist import, YouTube playlist import, ISRC lookup, MixV2, video URLs, similar albums, user playlist management, and rich now-playing embeds.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Tidal OAuth credentials globally for the bot owner. It does not store data associated with individual Discord users.
